page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the x86_64 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores and 64 vCPUs utilizing the AMD EPYC 7T83 processor running at a clock speed of 2.55 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Benchmark results place the ecs.c7a.16xlarge in the top 25% for several compute-heavy and memory-access workloads. The instance demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance with a stress-ng score of 86349.63 and a PassMark CPU score of 59199.92. It also excels in cryptographic operations, database operations, and Redis SET operations, the latter reaching 61.81 million operations per second. However, memory bandwidth for uncached large blocks falls into the average category, with read speeds of 85.04 GB/sec and write speeds of 38.03 GB/sec.

The dedicated CPU allocation and high core count make this instance suitable for compute-bound workloads such as multi-threaded decompression, ray tracing, and small-model LLM inference. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators represents a clear tradeoff, requiring external storage configuration and limiting its utility for large-scale deep learning training. Given the 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, it offers qualitative cost efficiency for high-density CPU processing tasks that do not require massive memory footprints.
